# EDA\

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
dat <- read_csv("all-teams-2025-roster.csv")
head(dat)
slice_sample(dat, n = 8)
```

```{r}
dim(dat)
dat |> distinct(team) |> pull(team)
dat |> distinct(team) |> pull(team) |> length()
dat |> distinct(position) |> pull(position)
```
## Univariate Analysis\

### Sanity Check\
```{r}
summary(dat$height)
```
Note: summary() != summarize()

### Visual Inspection (histogram, density plot, boxplot)
```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white")

ggplotly(
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white")
)
```

```{r}
dat |> 
  slice_min(height) |> 
  select(player, team, position, height, country)

dat |> 
  slice_max(height) |> 
  select(player, team, position, height, country)

dat |> 
  mutate(height_m = height * 0.0254) |> 
  summarize(avg_height_in = mean(height),
            avg_height_m = mean(height_m))
```

## Bivariate Analysis\
- height and weight
- height and position
- height and team

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = weight)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = weight)) +
  geom_point(color = "green3", alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(
  ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = weight, label = player)) +
    geom_point(color = "green3", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_bw()
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = position)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = position)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = position)) +
  geom_violin()

dat |> 
  group_by(position) |> 
  summarize(
    min_ht = min(height),
    avg_ht = mean(height),
    max_ht = max(height)) |> 
  arrange(avg_ht)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ position)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ position, scales = "free_y")


```

```{r}
ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = team)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = team, color = team)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height, y = team)) +
  geom_boxplot()

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ team)

ggplot(dat, aes(x = height)) +
  geom_density() +
  facet_wrap(~ team)
```

```{r}
dat |> 
  group_by(team) |> 
  summarize(avg_ht = mean(height)) |> 
  arrange(desc(avg_ht)) |> 
  print(n = 30)

dat |> 
  group_by(team) |> 
  summarize(avg_ht = mean(height)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_ht, y = team)) +
  geom_col()

dat |> 
  group_by(team) |> 
  summarize(avg_ht = mean(height)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_ht, y = reorder(team, avg_ht))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "average height", y = "")
```
